description: This file defines the internal class RebalancerCompatibleRule, which implements several interfaces related to cluster rebalancing and silo status management within the Orleans runtime. It manages cluster imbalance tolerances, reacts to silo status changes, reports, and cluster imbalance updates, and adjusts rebalancing parameters accordingly.

classes.name: RebalancerCompatibleRule
classes.description: An internal class implementing imbalance tolerance rules and cluster rebalancing logic, aware of cluster size and rebalancer state, using various Orleans interfaces to respond to cluster events.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the provided imbalance is within the tolerated pairwise imbalance threshold.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles silo status change notifications and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the rule to the silo lifecycle events.

methods.name: OnReport
methods.description: Handles reports about cluster imbalance and updates the internal state.

methods.name: UpdatePairwiseImbalance
methods.description: Calculates and updates the pairwise imbalance threshold based on current cluster silo statuses and imbalance.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Starts the rebalancer compatibility rule by subscribing to necessary cluster events.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops the rebalancer compatibility rule by unsubscribing from cluster events.
